verdict.rationale: Ente ships an official CLI that its Auth docs point to for automatically backing up Auth codes [ente-auth-docs-11]. A runtime probe confirms it is packaged in Homebrew as ente-cli 0.3.0, described as a utility for exporting Ente data and decrypting Auth exports [ente-auth-probe-rt-1]. Its documented scope is narrow, covering scriptable export and backup only. Missing for 10: CLI operations beyond export/decrypt (generating, listing, adding or managing codes), in-depth CLI command documentation, and independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven CLI use.
